checks.text: Uploading a JPEG receipt photo shows a thumbnail in the list with "Receipt 1" as the label.
Clicking "Add Another Receipt" lets the user upload a second PNG receipt photo.
After adding two receipts, clicking "Generate PDF" creates a downloadable PDF with both receipts and a cover sheet.
The cover sheet lists each receipt's label, date and amount, taken from the "Date" and "Amount" fields of that receipt.
With a receipt whose "Date" is "2025-04-05", the PDF is saved with the filename "Receipt Packet_2025-04-05.pdf".
Selecting "Send to Expenses App" saves the PDF and shows the text "Sent to Expenses App: Receipt Packet_2025-04-05.pdf" in the status area.
Clicking "Crop" on a receipt opens a crop panel with the fields "Crop width" and "Crop height" (pixels); setting 100 and 80 and clicking "Apply crop" shows the text "Cropped to 100 × 80".
Clicking the button "Rotate" on a receipt rotates its thumbnail by 90 degrees (its `data-rotation` goes from 0 to 90).
Reload keeps the list of uploaded receipts with their original labels and thumbnails.
